title: Bujeti is turning finance operations into infrastructure that runs itself with 15+ integrations | Bujeti
summary: All-in-one financial management for African businesses. Track expenses, automate payments, issue corporate cards, and streamline your finances with Bujeti.
body_markdown:
*Connect the tools you already run on, and let payments, sales, and accounting work as one.*


Growing a business in Africa often means running finance across a patchwork of tools. Payments land in one processor, deals close in another, and the books live somewhere else entirely. Someone spends hours each week moving numbers between systems that were never built to talk to each other, and the cost shows up as slow collections, reconciliation gaps, and decisions made on figures that are already out of date. It is a hidden tax on growth because the bigger you get, the more tools you add, and the wider those gaps become.


Today, Bujeti now connects natively to 15+ of the tools businesses already run on, across payments, banking, CRM, accounting and automation. The result is simple to describe and, once you see it, hard to give up. A closed deal becomes an invoice, an invoice gets chased until it is paid, and every transaction lands in your books, without anyone lifting a finger.


#####


##### Integrations across payments, banking, CRM, accounting and automation


Each one of the integrations takes a task off your plate, whether that is reconciling a payment, raising an invoice, or posting to your ledger. Here is what each does, grouped by where it sits in your money flow, and how to switch it on.


######


###### Payments Integrations


Connect your payment processors and your collections, settlements, payouts, refunds, and chargebacks flow into Bujeti automatically, sitting right next to your budgets and reconciliation. When an invoice tied to one of these payments goes unpaid, Chaser, our automated follow-up Teammate, picks it up and pursues it for you.


-


**Stripe** pulls your payments, settlements, payouts, and refunds into Bujeti so you can stop exporting CSVs just to reconcile.[Learn how to set up Stripe →](https://help.bujeti.com/en/articles/16992774-how-to-connect-and-use-stripe-on-bujeti)


-


**Paystack** syncs your collections and settlements in near real time, so what you collect and what lands in the bank line up on their own.[Learn how to setup Paystack](http://help.bujeti.com/en/articles/17031285-how-to-connect-and-use-paystack-on-bujeti)


-


**Flutterwave** puts your money in and out in one view, so settlements and refunds match without a spreadsheet in the middle.[Learn how to set up Flutterwave →](https://help.bujeti.com/en/articles/16994292-how-to-connect-and-use-flutterwave-on-bujeti)


######


###### Bank Integrations


Connect a bank feed and your account activity flows into Bujeti automatically, so your balances and transactions sit next to everything else instead of behind a separate login. It turns reconciliation from a login-by-login hunt into something that is already done by the time you look. We are starting with Kuda, with more banks on the way.


-


**Kuda Business** imports your account activity and balances so Kuda sits beside your other accounts in one dashboard, and reconciliation stops being an account-by-account chore.[Learn how to set up Kuda Business →](https://help.bujeti.com/en/articles/17000366-how-to-connect-and-use-kuda-business-on-bujeti)


######


###### CRM Integrations


Link your CRM and the moment a deal is won it becomes a draft invoice in Bujeti, built from the customer and amount already in the deal. As that invoice moves through its life, its status flows back onto the deal, so sales can see what has been billed and paid without pinging finance, and finance never has to retype a thing.


-


**HubSpot** turns a closed-won deal into a draft invoice and keeps the deal updated as the invoice progresses.


-


**Pipedrive** makes a won deal invoice-ready in Bujeti and writes the status back on its own.


-


**Zoho CRM** hands a won deal straight to billing, so receivables start the instant the deal is done, with nothing retyped.


-


**Odoo CRM** connects your Odoo instance so won opportunities to create invoices in Bujeti.


######


###### Accounting Tool Integrations


Your accounting tool connected so Bujeti pushes categorised transactions and expenses into the ledger as money moves. Vendor payouts, bulk payments, reimbursements, and scheduled activity all post automatically, categorised and matched, so month-end stops being a fire drill and your books reflect reality rather than last week's export.


-


**QuickBooks Online** receives your transactions with matching and categorisation already done, leaving you audit-ready.


-


**Zoho Books** stays current as money moves in Bujeti, so reporting is ready when you are


-


**Xero** takes in clean, categorised activity as your general ledger, with no spreadsheet cleanup afterwards.


-


**Tyms** keeps your bookkeeping in sync, and if you are not on Tyms yet, Bujeti can set you up on the spot.


-


**Odoo Accounting** takes your Bujeti transactions into your Odoo ERP books in near real time, as a separate connection from Odoo CRM.


######


###### Automation


With an automation tool connected, Bujeti plugs into the workflows you already run. A finance event in Bujeti, a payment received, an invoice raised, can trigger actions across your other apps, and activity in those apps can flow back into Bujeti.


-


**Zapier** connects Bujeti to thousands of apps, so you can automate the finance workflows that are unique to how you run, no engineering required.


-


**Make** builds richer, multi-step automations between Bujeti and your other tools, for the workflows that need more than a single trigger and action.


#####


##### What it means for your business


The integrations are not the story on their own. What they unlock for your business is the real benefit. When your payments, sales, and accounting all connect to Bujeti, the busywork between them simply stops happening, and a few things change at once.


-


**Real-time visibility:** Cash position, collections, settlements, and spend update as money moves, so founders, CFOs, and finance teams all work from numbers that are current, not a month old.


-


**Faster cash in:** Invoices are raised the moment a deal is won and chased automatically until they are paid, shortening the time between closing revenue and banking it.


-


**Control that scales:** Approval rules, budgets, and policy enforcement extend across every connected system, so control does not weaken as you add tools, entities, or headcount.


-


**Fewer people do manual work:** Reconciliation, invoice creation, and payment follow-up run on their own, freeing teams of any size to move from data entry to the work that grows the business.


######


###### A bigger picture ahead


This launch is one piece of a bigger idea we have been building toward: finance should not sit off to the side as a system of record you check after the fact. It should run quietly in the background and push the business forward. That is the same thinking behind Bujeti Brain, our AI Teammates that already handle document capture, collections, financial controls, and the everyday finance questions of your team fields. The integrations carry that reach outward, into the tools you already depend on, so all of it works as one.


Today is a starting point, not a finish line. More connections are on the way, and every one fills in more of the picture, until you have a single platform that sees your money end to end and takes more of the work off your hands. The goal has not changed, and we are building toward it deliberately: less time spent running finance, and more spent growing the business it exists to serve.


######


###### Secure by design


Every connection uses scoped access, OAuth where the partner supports it, keys and webhook secrets otherwise, and never your login password. Access is limited to the specific payment, deal, or bookkeeping data each integration needs, nothing more, and you can disconnect any connection from Bujeti at any time. For anyone accountable for how company data is handled, that control is built in from the start, not bolted on after.


#####


##### Get started


All 15+ native integrations are available today. Open your[Bujeti dashboard,](https://dashboard.bujeti.com/) go to Integrations, and connect the tools you already run on. Not on Bujeti yet? Book a demo and we will show you how it works on your own finance operations.
